feeds.title: Captain Laura News
feeds.description: Laura Einsetler is a commercial airline pilot with over 30 years of flying experience in various aircraft around the world. She is an Airline Pilot, Author & Guest Speaker. Sharing knowledge, passion, and experience to educate, motivate and empower through her blog articles.

feeds.title: Dutch Pilot Girl
feeds.description: Hi everyone! I hope you are having a great day! My name is Michelle Gooris. I am a Dutch airline pilot currently living in Amsterdam and Milan. In this blog, I am sharing the experiences I hope to motivate and inspire people to make their dreams of becoming a pilot a reality.

feeds.title: Fly with Eva
feeds.description: Hi! I am Eva Claire Marseille. I started this website to share some of my stories and flying experiences, to inform, and to be visible to a new generation.

feeds.title: Cosy Life » Flying
feeds.description: HI! I am Rachel Ramsay a freelance copywriter and private pilot living in the Cotswolds. This blog records my adventures, discoveries and efforts to make life a bit more interesting.

feeds.title: AOPA
feeds.description: A listing of all current AOPA Blogs with a description and links to the main page of each publication. Whether you're a pilot or an aviation enthusiast, this is the place where you can join the conversations about general aviation.
